title: Story agent: reads everything, makes new variations when asked
description: One high-level conversation per Story on the existing story_conversation MessageThread (anchor item#lineage), editors posting as today and the agent replying with authorKind AI. Pi-based, Chatticus-compatible shape. Tools: read the Story, its variations and the thread, search the knowledge base, offer a requested variation that records requestMessageId and basedOnVariationIds. Start with a spike on where it runs.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Waits on the Chatticus work in PPY-e4a872. Ryan 2026-11-02: no Papyrus-only agent as a stopgap, so ignore 'Start with a spike on where it runs'. Also open: which system holds the Story conversation.
